en.headline: Motorcyclist dies after Route Twisk collision, police say
en.dek: A 35-year-old rider died after a light goods vehicle left the scene in Pat Heung on Wednesday night.
body: A 35-year-old motorcyclist has died after a collision on Route Twisk in Pat Heung, police said. The crash happened at about 9pm on Wednesday.

Police said the man was riding towards Tsuen Wan when he was believed to have been struck by the side mirror of a light goods vehicle travelling in the opposite lane. He lost balance and fell, injuring his hands and legs. The goods vehicle did not stop and left the scene.

He was taken to Pok Oi Hospital and was certified dead at about midnight, police said. The New Territories North Regional Traffic Unit special investigation team is following up. Officers asked anyone who saw the crash, or who has information, to call 3661 3800.
No arrest had been reported by Thursday afternoon. Police have not named the rider.

zh.headline: 荃錦公路電單車司機送院後不治
zh.dek: 八鄉昨晚一輛輕型貨車疑以倒後鏡撞到電單車後駛離，35歲司機延至凌晨不治。
body: 八鄉荃錦公路發生致命交通意外。警方說，一名35歲電單車司機傷重不治，事發於星期三晚上約9時。
警方表示，該名男子當時沿荃錦公路往荃灣方向行駛，懷疑被對面行車線一輛輕型貨車的倒後鏡撞到，失平衡跌倒，手及腿部受傷。涉事貨車沒有停下，並駛離現場。
他被送往博愛醫院，延至今日凌晨約12時證實死亡。新界北總區交通部特別調查隊正在跟進，呼籲目擊或有資料的人士致電3661 3800聯絡調查人員。
截至星期四下午，警方未有公布拘捕。警方沒有公布死者姓名。
